goals.name: Reduce sediment yields by 55%-66%
goals.description: The plan's primary water quality target, drawn from the Dry Creek sediment TMDL. It calls for cutting sediment yields enough to reflect stable stream conditions.
goals.targetText: sediment yields reduced by 55%-66% in the watershed in order to reflect stable conditions
goals.sourceQuote: The sediment TMDL for Dry Creek (MS082E) concluded that sediment yields would need to be reduced by 55%-66% in the watershed in order to reflect stable conditions.

goals.name: Attain M-BISQ attainment threshold for East bioregion (71.6)
goals.description: Dry Creek was listed for biological impairment. Restoring the Aquatic Life Designated Use means M-BISQ scores above the East bioregion attainment threshold of 71.6.
goals.targetText: score above the attainment threshold for the bioregion (Aquatic Life Designated Use attainment)
goals.sourceQuote: Dry Creek is in the East bioregion and the attainment threshold is 71.6.

goals.name: Behavior change and BMP use to improve water quality
goals.description: The stated ultimate goal of the information and education effort. It aims to change behavior and increase BMP adoption so that water quality and quality of life in the watershed improve.
goals.targetText: improve water quality and the overall quality of life in the watershed
goals.sourceQuote: The ultimate goal is to bring about behavior changes and the use of “best management practices” that will improve water quality and the overall quality of life in the watershed.

bmps.name: Fencing
bmps.description: Fencing to manage grazing on pastures recently converted from forest, intended to reduce sediment delivery to Dry Creek. The plan budgets it as a 319-funded BMP.
bmps.location: Priority areas (newly converted pasture) in Dry Creek watershed
bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

bmps.name: Water Facilities
bmps.description: Livestock watering facilities that support grazing management on newly converted pastures, reducing sediment from livestock access.
bmps.location: Priority areas (newly converted pasture) in Dry Creek watershed
bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

bmps.name: Heavy Use Areas
bmps.description: Heavy use area protection for livestock concentration areas on pasture, intended to limit erosion and sediment runoff.
bmps.location: Priority areas (newly converted pasture) in Dry Creek watershed
bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

bmps.name: Stream Crossings
bmps.description: Stabilized stream crossings for livestock and equipment, intended to reduce streambank erosion and in-channel sediment.
bmps.location: Priority areas (newly converted pasture) in Dry Creek watershed
bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

bmps.name: Ponds
bmps.description: Ponds proposed to support grazing operations and trap sediment in the watershed.

bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

bmps.name: Sediment Basins

bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

bmps.description: Nutrient management practices (lime and fertilizer) on pasture to establish vegetative cover and control nutrient and sediment losses.
bmps.location: Priority areas (newly converted pasture) in Dry Creek watershed
bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

bmps.name: Critical Area Planting
bmps.description: Vegetative planting of critical eroding areas to stabilize soil and reduce sediment runoff.
bmps.location: Priority areas (newly converted pasture) in Dry Creek watershed
bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

bmps.name: Establishment of Permanent Vegetation
bmps.description: Establishing permanent vegetative cover on newly converted pasture to reduce erosion and sedimentation.
bmps.location: Priority areas (newly converted pasture) in Dry Creek watershed
bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

bmps.name: Forage and Biomass Planting
bmps.description: Planting forage and biomass species on pasture to improve ground cover and reduce sediment loss.
bmps.location: Priority areas (newly converted pasture) in Dry Creek watershed
bmps.sectionTitle: Element d: Technical and Financial Assistance

monitoring.name: Dissolved Oxygen daily average threshold

monitoring.description: Water temperature criterion of not exceeding 90°F used to measure compliance with water quality criteria.

monitoring.name: Total Suspended Solids monitoring
monitoring.description: TSS will be measured as a surrogate for sediment concentrations, since there is no numeric sediment criterion.
monitoring.sourceQuote: monitoring will be conducted to collect data on parameters that are considered surrogates for sediment concentrations and may include measurements for Total Suspend Solids, Total Suspended Sediment, and turbidity

monitoring.name: Total Suspended Sediment monitoring
